title: Family law
intro: We have extensive experience of all areas of family law. Our aim is to always try and secure a negotiated settlement but, if need arises, we are regular and confident litigators in all of these fields:
summary: Divorce, children, adoption and separation agreements, negotiated where possible and litigated where needed.

title: Court and crime
intro: When it comes to the more adversarial, sharp end of the law we carry a deserved reputation for fighting for our clients. This includes:
summary: Criminal defence, personal injury claims, actions for payment and redundancy agreements.

title: Homes, wills and executries
intro: In addition to our litigation work we also provide a full private client service in the following areas:
summary: Buying and selling property, wills, executries, trusts, guardianships and powers of attorney.

title: Specialist referrals
intro: A small firm cannot cover every area of the law, so we keep a network of specialist firms we can refer you to, at no cost to you. Areas covered include:
summary: Referrals to specialist firms for employment, immigration, company and landlord and tenant matters.
